samples.summary: New `data-font-weights` wiring in FontFamilyPicker is not distinguished by any test
samples.evidence: The picker now emits `data-font-weights={entry?.weights}` (recents, line 221) and `data-font-weights={entry.weights}` (catalog rows, line 251), and the observer forwards `row.dataset.fontWeights`. No test asserts the resulting weight: `font-family-picker.test.ts:345-369` ('a row scrolling into view previews exactly that family') only asserts the marker attribute and `text=Open Sas`, never the `wght@` segment. Moreover the attribute is derived from `CATALOG_BY_FAMILY` (= FONT_CATALOG), the same map `ensurePreviewFontLink` falls back to via `CATALOG_INDEX`, so deleting both attributes would change nothing observable and every test would still pass. Contrast `more-fonts-dialog.test.ts:172-176`, which does pin the weight (`family=Lobster:wght@700`) because its stub catalog diverges from the real one — the picker has no equivalent case (e.g. a recents family absent from the curated catalog).

`previewWeight` ends `return first || DEFAULT_WEIGHTS;` (font-catalog.ts:186), i.e. an empty or leading-semicolon weights spec (`""`, `";400"`, `" "`) yields the two-weight string `400;700` from a function documented to return 'the single weight a preview requests'. Every new test passes either a valid single/multi weight ('700', '300;400;700'), undefined, or relies on the catalog entry (ensure-font-link.test.ts:171-192); none exercises an empty/blank `weights`, which is reachable because the value comes from a DOM `dataset` attribute (`data-font-weights={entry?.weights}` renders nothing for undefined, but any future empty-string entry flows straight through).

samples.summary: Dialog preview test never asserts that no FULL family link is injected, and its cleanup ignores full links
samples.evidence: The new test 'an in-view row previews a subset covering label and group name' (more-fonts-dialog.test.ts:147-177) asserts only over `previewLinks()`. There is no `fontLinks()` helper or assertion in this file, so a regression where the dialog injects both a subset and a full `data-wafflebase-font` link (defeating the whole byte-saving purpose of the change) would still pass. The `afterEach` (line 85-86) likewise removes only preview links, so any full link leaks across tests in the file and could silently make a later `ensurePreviewFontLink` no-op. The sibling picker test does assert `expect(fontLinks()).toHaveLength(0)` (font-family-picker.test.ts:362).

samples.summary: 'selecting a previewed-only family still loads the full family' proves the harness, not the component
samples.evidence: The test wires `onChange: ensureFontLink` (line 376), so the full link it then asserts on (lines 401-404) is injected by the test's own callback, not by any production code path. The component contributes nothing beyond delivering the family string, which is already covered by 'fires onChange with the catalog family on item click'. The marker-split behavior it claims to pin is the same assertion as the pure unit test 'a previewed family still loads in full when selected' (ensure-font-link.test.ts:145-157). The real production wiring (`app/slides/toolbar/apply-font-family.ts`, `onPrefetch={ensureFontLink}`) is not exercised here, so this component test cannot fail for any component-level reason.
searchedFor: grep ensureFontLink call sites in packages/frontend/src

samples.summary: The scrollRef→state fix is only implicitly covered (no explicit 'observer was created' assertion)
samples.evidence: The behavioral fix in this diff (`useRef` → `useState` callback ref, more-fonts-dialog.tsx:102/211, deps `[open, results, scrollEl]`) is only exercised because the new test does `observers.at(-1)!` (more-fonts-dialog.test.ts:164) — the test fails by TypeError rather than by a stated assertion, and there is no assertion that rows were actually observed. The picker test explicitly guards this shape (`expect(observers.at(-1)!.observed.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`, font-family-picker.test.ts:336); the dialog test would read far more clearly with the same guard.

samples.summary: The documented motivating case — previewing a family absent from CATALOG_INDEX (recents / full library) — has no component-level test
samples.evidence: `ensurePreviewFontLink`'s doc comment (font-catalog.ts:212-215) justifies taking `text` and `weights` from the DOM because 'recents and the full library both contain families absent from CATALOG_INDEX'. No test drives that path through a component: the picker tests never seed `font-recents` localStorage, so the recents branch (`data-font-row`/`data-font-weights` on DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, font-family-picker.tsx:218-233) is never observed, and the dialog test uses a stub catalog whose families all exist in the real catalog. Only the direct unit calls with FAKE_* families cover off-catalog behavior.
